Tests markdown output format via bytes extraction API

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from pathlib import Path
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput, ExtractionConfig, FileExtractionConfig, ExtractInputKind, OutputFormat

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(bytes=Path("pdf/fake_memo.pdf").read_bytes(), config=FileExtractionConfig(output_format=OutputFormat("markdown")), filename="fake_memo.pdf", kind=ExtractInputKind("bytes"), mime_type="application/pdf")
    config = ExtractionConfig(output_format=OutputFormat("markdown"))
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result.results[0].mime_type)
    print(result.results[0].content)
    print(result.results[0].metadata.output_format)

asyncio.run(main())
```
